{{Quote|The pay is lousy, the food is even worse<br />But we're tougher 'n' a Wookiee's stomach,<br />And meaner 'n' a Princess's curse.|"Yer in the Rebellion Now, Farmboy," an Alliance fighting song|<ref name="RASB" />}}
'''"Yer in the Rebellion Now, Farmboy"''' was a popular fighting [[Music/Legends|song]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was considered somewhat obscene.<ref name="RASB" />
